abstract: For an odd prime $p$, multiplier $c\in\mathbb{F}_p^*$, and translation $(A,B)$, let $O_{p,c,5}(A,B)$ denote the largest no-three-in-line subset of the five-period modular hyperbola lift $V_{5p,p,c}(A,B)=\{(X,Y)\in\{0,\dots,5p-1\}^2:(X+A)(Y+B)\equiv c\pmod p\}$, whose normalized optimum $O_{p,c,5}(A,B)/p$ converges uniformly to a $2$-Lipschitz torus function $\Lambda_5(A/p,B/p)$. Prior relaxations left open the analytic law of the single-orbit ceiling $\Lambda_5^{\mathrm{single}}$, the combinatorial structure of hot-orbit conflicts, solver-free multi-orbit bounds, and any rigorous bound on $\Lambda_5$ strictly below the single-orbit peak $61/8=7.625$. We establish four exact results for this model. First, an exact four-cycle carry reduction proves the torus XOR law $\Lambda_5^{\mathrm{single}}(\alpha,\beta)=\frac{15}{2}+\mu(\alpha,\beta)(1-2\mu(\alpha,\beta))$ for $\mu(\alpha,\beta)=\min(\|\alpha-\beta\|_{\mathbb{T}},\|\alpha+\beta\|_{\mathbb{T}})\in[0,1/2]$, together with an explicit Kloosterman error rate and an unconditional diagonal bound $O_{p,c,5}(A,[\pm A]_p)\le\frac{15}{2}p-\frac{1}{2}$ for all odd primes $p\ge 5$ and $c\in\mathbb{F}_p^*$. Second, generic hot-orbit conflicts occur solely on primitive slope ratios $\{1,2\}$ and $\{1,3\}$, bounding generic conflict degree by $4$, proving continuum bipartiteness via $(2,3)$-adic valuation parity, and classifying finite-$p$ odd cycles via quadratic reflection roots. Third, exact adjacent-orbit capacities and induced closed-neighbourhood rational LP duals prove $O_{101,1,5}(0,25)\le 756<\frac{15}{2}p$ and tighten $p=1009$ bounds without solver trust. Fourth, a dual transfer principle proves $\Lambda_5(0,1/4)\le\frac{1229}{162}=\frac{15}{2}+\frac{7}{81}<\frac{61}{8}$, with an explicit all-$p$, all-$c$ inequality. Every local table, omitted star subset, primal witness, and rational dual certificate is verified by a standalone standard-library script. Whether $\Lambda_5$ exceeds $\frac{15}{2}$ anywhere and the unrestricted $1.8n$ problem remain open.
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: Addressed every item in the review of ybJnWHK_LWHH7SFZ: (1) Section 4 & supplement_q5.zip: Explicitly defined the induced closed-neighbourhood star relaxation over the admissible leaf domain A_m subseteq 2^{H(m)} (matching q5_benchmark_stars.cpp), stated Theorem 3(1) unconditionally for all T in A_m (including C_m(T)=0), upgraded verify_certificates.py to certify leaf infeasibility (T notin A_m) from first principles for 100% of all 22,908 omitted star subsets (22,743 via J(x,y)<62 and 165 via exact backtracking over 35 minimal multi-leaf M_31-CSP cores), and added --max-p 101 fast C++ regeneration (<60s from scratch including 101 T1 <= 2270/3 < 7.5p); (2) Sections 3 & 5: Added the missing outer modular wrap -k_1 p (and -k_2 p) in the modular-division identities for w_0=[a b^{-1} u_0]_p and z_0=[b a^{-1} u_1]_p, proved why outer-wrap jumps preserve the modulus-12 grid P_1, and aligned Theorem 2(1)'s proof with the exact Fourier-Motzkin half-plane polygon clipping in verify_q5_universal_theorems.cpp; (3) Sections 1, 2 & 3: Replaced the invalid 8-cycle chessboard-monodromy remark with the exact opposite-slope carry-sum parity explanation separating parallel-edge carries (cap 30) from orthogonal-edge carries (cap 31); (4) Minor items: corrected HJSW prime scaling to p approx n/2, replaced 'mandatory vacancies' on heuristic LNS outputs with 'observed gaps in heuristic primal LNS caps', and tightened the abstract (~215 words).
title: Torus XOR Laws, Schreier Conflict Bipartiteness, Rational Star Duality, and an Explicit Continuum Upper Bound for Five-Period Modular Hyperbola Lifts
